title: security(rbac-v2): enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Aisha Khan
description: Motivation: customers in regulated industries require deterministic data residency for customer-managed keys (KMS) and stronger audit trails tied to RBAC v2. This PR hardens RBAC v2 enforcement for KMS region pinning and extends audit logging to include KMS residency metadata and decision rationale so SOC & compliance teams can verify policy decisions. Summary: 1) Add region-pinning enforcement path to RBAC v2 policy engine and fail fast when user/request KMS key region is incompatible with resource residency constraints. 2) Expand audit log schema to include: requested_kms_key_arn, kms_key_region, policy_rule_id, enforcement_decision, and a short reason string. 3) Add policy migration utility to mark existing keys as "residency-aware" and a feature flag to roll out enforcement gradually. 4) New unit and integration tests, plus an eval harness to validate cross-region fallback logic. Checklist: - [x] Policy engine changes implemented - [x] Audit schema changes + migration script - [x] Tests: unit + integration + e2e-security - [x] Feature flag gating and rollout notes - [x] Docs updated (RBAC v2 and Ops runbook) - [x] Verified CI passing and security scan clean Notes on rollout: Enforcement is behind feature flag rbac_v2.kms_region_pinning.enforce; default = off. On enable the system will reject requests where key region mismatches resource residency unless an explicit override role is present. Migration script will tag keys and backfill audit fields for existing logs. Backcompat: existing RBAC v2 checks remain unchanged unless the flag is toggled. See release_notes for customer-facing summary.

release_notes: Security: RBAC v2 now supports enforcement of KMS region pinning and richer audit logging for KMS residency. Rollout: enforcement is gated behind feature flag rbac_v2.kms_region_pinning.enforce (default=off). Operators should run the provided migration backfill with --dry-run to verify tagging. Backwards compatible unless flag is enabled.
customer_impact: Low by default (feature gated). When enabled, requests using KMS keys from the wrong region will be rejected unless the requestor has an override role. Operators must coordinate enabling with key tagging and migration backfill.
notes_for_ops: Run migrations/2026_01_kms_residency_backfill.go with --dry-run then in batches. Monitor console/alerts/rbac_residency_alert.rules and metrics rbac.enforcement.denied_by_kms_region. If false positives occur, use the override role to unblock callers while adjusting policy templates.
